column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each location record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking location data to a specific piece of equipment.
A TIMESTAMP recording when the location data was captured or logged.
A TEXT field giving the name of the station, camp, or site.
An enum (LocationType_enum) describing if it is an 'Arctic' or 'Antarctic' location (e.g., Arctic, Antarctic).
A NUMERIC(9,6) representing the latitude of the location in decimal degrees.
A NUMERIC(9,6) representing the longitude of the location in decimal degrees.
A DECIMAL(7,2) specifying the altitude (in meters) above sea level.
